summary:
I’m a driven individual with a high level of intellectual curiosity, applying technology to solve complex problems.
Originally from Honduras, I completed an honors degree in Technology Management in Munich and am currently researching at the Laboratory for Innovation Science at Harvard. My journey has taken me through academic and professional experiences in Switzerland, Singapore, Germany, and the United States. I’m fluent in Spanish, English, and German.

positions.description:
Concerned about the situation our environment is going through, I started Refyl with two other students looking to achieve a reduction in the use of plastic in the cosmetic industry. Working on Refyl made me research and immerse myself in the plastic and cosmetics industry. 
I was in charge of the Business Development of Refyl which ranges from building and updating the Business Model Canvas and Value Proposition Canvas to doing Stakeholder Analysis, Competitive Analysis and the Customer Journey Map.

The learnings I acquired from the process were very valuable.
